Variants.Content: Carpathian routes and rivers connect interior, plains and neighbors. Narrow roads offer defence but can congest carts and dependants.

Carpathian routes and rivers connect Gepid settlements with plains. Travelers and guards use specific banks, entrances and stops; outward access does not ensure return. Narrow roads defend and also congest carts and dependants.
